correctness.rationale: Exact arithmetic on Z[golden ratio] verifies the 20 vertices, all 12 exposed pentagonal facets, 30 edges, ten antipodal vertex-normal axes and pairwise dot products. Pairwise great-circle intersections are distinct. For each of the 1024 possible signed halfspace patterns, a cone-extreme-ray completeness theorem reduces feasibility to the 90 oriented exact cross-product rays. Exactly 92 nonempty chambers occur; 20 six-vertex spherical hexagons correspond to 6-sided sections, 60 spherical triangles to 8, and 12 spherical pentagons to 10. Their exact interior angles yield Girard areas and the three probabilities with normalization 4pi. Independent 30-edge crossing expectation equals the distribution expectation. The finite exhaustive computation is limited to this fixed polytope.
